decision: Resolve O02-SG001 prospectively and authorize only the bounded resolving sequence C01-0008, C02-0004, B04-0009, O02-0002, C04-0004, and the next-unused final B04 packaging attempt. Add strict Draft 2020-12 canonical RetrievalCandidate at schemas/retrieval-candidate.schema.json with its matching example, increasing the active canonical inventory from 126/126 to 127 schemas and 127 examples and the packaged inventory to 127 schemas plus one OpenAPI resource, 128 resources total; all prior 126/126 records remain immutable history. RetrievalCandidate uses additionalProperties=false and requires candidate_id, run_id, query_plan_id, plan_hash, lane, query_family, query_text, query_hash, scope_filter, corpus_snapshot_hash, index_versions, backend_id, backend_version, backend_adapter_id, backend_adapter_version, backend_request_hash, backend_response_hash, backend_receipt_id, canonical_source_key, source_record_id, source_artifact_id, source_locator, source_version, source_snapshot_hash, source_span_id, raw_rank, raw_scores, channel_ranks, retrieval_channels, fusion_method, fusion_score, ranking_features, matched_terms, matched_edges, relation_direction, scope_estimate, duplicate_candidate_ids, multi_channel_verified, retrieval_explanation, and candidate_hash; nullable values retain their keys. candidate_id is RC- plus the lowercase SHA-256 of the JCS-equivalent identity preimage containing plan_hash, lane, query_hash, canonical_source_key, source_version, and source_snapshot_hash. candidate_hash is sha256: plus the lowercase SHA-256 of the full canonical candidate content including resolved provenance, backend observations, ranks, scores, features, and duplicate lineage while excluding candidate_id, candidate_hash, generated time, and storage locator. Metadata-only candidates with source_span_id null may be retained but cannot become EvidenceNode or promoted evidence directly. Freeze query-family vocabulary to FORWARD, REVERSE, NULL, BOUNDARY, METHOD, and NOVELTY; retrieval-channel vocabulary to LEXICAL, SEMANTIC, CITATION_GRAPH, RELATION_GRAPH, and EXTERNAL_INDEX; relation-direction vocabulary to SAME_DIRECTION, REVERSE_DIRECTION, INVERSE_PREDICATE, BIDIRECTIONAL, NO_DIRECTION, and UNRESOLVED. Every provider-neutral backend request seals run_id, query_plan_id, plan_hash, lane, query_families, canonical query_batch, query_hash, scope_filter, corpus_snapshot_hash, index_versions, max_candidates, cutoff_policy_id, deterministic_seed, policy_bundle_hash, capability_lease_id, backend_id, backend_version, adapter_id, and adapter_version. SearchLaneReceipt.query_text stores the exact canonical query_batch JSON string and query_hash stores its UTF-8 SHA-256. Raw backend responses are untrusted until schema, query, snapshot, index, rank, source locator, and receipt validation succeeds. Freeze lane-to-family mapping as lexical/semantic/citation/entity_variable/mechanism/temporal to FORWARD, counterevidence to FORWARD plus REVERSE, null to NULL, boundary to BOUNDARY, method to METHOD, and external_novelty to NOVELTY; temporal additionally requires a versioned date/correction filter and external_novelty requires an external scope and stop rule. Missing required families fail closed with INVALID_QUERY_FAMILY_BINDING. Direction semantics are exact: canonical A parent_of B is SAME_DIRECTION, B parent_of A is REVERSE_DIRECTION, registered inverse B child_of A is INVERSE_PREDICATE, explicit claims in both directions are BIDIRECTIONAL, a symmetric relation is NO_DIRECTION, and insufficient trustworthy grounding is UNRESOLVED. NO_DIRECTION and UNRESOLVED are not direction matches and an LLM cannot invent inverse mappings. Freeze processing order to backend response and receipt validation, QueryPlan/corpus/index binding, canonical_source_key generation, exact duplicate collapse within channel, stable channel rank ordering, RRF fusion, transparent feature calculation, max-candidates cutoff, candidate_id ascending tie-break, and excluded/duplicate/cutoff count recording. RRF(d)=sum(1/(60+rank_channel(d))) with k=60; raw scores are not compared across channels, no learned reranker is allowed in O02-0002, and retrieval scores are not scientific evidence strength. Duplicate identity is canonical_source_key plus source_version plus source_snapshot_hash plus source_locator; same-lane duplicates retain all channel observations and lineage while O03 owns cross-lane dependency deduplication. plan_hash, corpus_snapshot_hash, index_versions, backend and adapter versions, policy_bundle_hash, and cutoff policy are immutable for a lane execution. Snapshot, index, hash, candidate, or receipt mismatch yields FAILED/integrity_failure with STALE_RETRIEVAL_SNAPSHOT where applicable. Policy denial, missing credentials, and missing required backend yield BLOCKED with typed reasons; provider errors and malformed/unknown responses yield FAILED; valid bounded interruption yields PARTIAL; only complete zero-result execution yields SEARCHED_NONE and complete non-empty execution yields SEARCHED_WITH_RESULTS. Silent cross-channel fallback is forbidden and incomplete planned backend or family work cannot be reported as a complete state. For E1 or higher, the O01-required lexical, semantic, citation, and temporal lanes must actually execute; a semantic-only run cannot PASS. A non-empty release set must include at least one LEXICAL, CITATION_GRAPH, RELATION_GRAPH, or EXTERNAL_INDEX origin. Vector-only candidates remain retained with multi_channel_verified=false and the run ceiling is PARTIAL. A fully executed bounded search with all required lanes SEARCHED_NONE may PASS. O01 owns QueryPlan, eleven-lane reconciliation, SearchLaneReceipt, and SearchCompletenessCertificate; O02 owns provider adapters, raw-response validation, RetrievalCandidate, lane-local dedupe/rank/fusion, and candidate-set results; O03 owns SourceSpan/EvidenceNode resolution, dependency clusters, and Evidence Pack. RetrievalCandidate artifacts are O02 business outputs and ResultEnvelope is telemetry only; the O01 sealer verifies candidate IDs, hashes, counts, query, snapshot, and index before creating receipts. Freeze local, versioned, network-free and LLM-free acceptance oracles: exact contract, direction, provenance, integrity rejection, invalid-response rejection, dedupe, and deterministic replay cases must be 100%; vector-only violations, silent fallback, skips, and xfails must be zero; every required lane must achieve Recall@20 at least 0.90 and nDCG@20 at least 0.85; fused Recall@20 must be at least 0.95; and critical counter, null, boundary, and method must-find cases must be 100%, without averaging away a failing lane. Apply only the exact C01, O02, B04 and existing C02/C04 surfaces listed in affected_artifact_ids; do not modify SearchLaneReceipt or O01 planning authority. Preserve O02-0001, E0084, generation 000084-a48e395d, every prior attempt, decision, RAH generation and evidence record, all reports and receipts, and the dirty worktree. Fleet and subagents remain forbidden. Each stage must produce report.json, commands.jsonl, review.md, machine-readable verification, RAH evidence, and a verified generation; a non-PASS stage blocks all later stages. completion_ready remains false until the entire external goal, source coverage, PRD, review, validation, and closeout gates actually pass.
rationale: O02-0001 correctly stopped before implementation because no active canonical candidate artifact, provider-neutral request, lane-family binding, relation-direction oracle, deterministic fusion and deduplication contract, snapshot failure semantics, executable non-vector guard, benchmark fixture or threshold, ownership boundary, or bounded resolving write scope existed. This decision supplies those product and scientific meanings without weakening O01, inventing evidence, accepting stale or vector-only results as complete, changing prior history, or treating retrieval scores as scientific support.
